ModMetaData.name: DMS - Tribute Collector Isolation / 征募代理隔离修复
ModMetaData.author: WhiteGiver (local patch)
ModMetaData.description:
将 DMS 征募代理移出原版帝国专用的 TributeCollector 随机池，避免帝国征募事件抽到冲压零件交易清单。只修改 DMS 征募代理的分类；保留双方的物品、囚犯交易、声望数值、DMS 商队与呼叫许可。纯 XML，无需 Harmony。
Separates the DMS recruitment agency from the Empire's TributeCollector event pool. Changes only its category; preserves both inventories, prisoner trading, honor values, DMS caravans and the recruitment-agency permit. XML only; no Harmony required.
